The launcher is redesigned: a full-screen menu that works the same with a mouse, a keyboard or a controller, with clearer text at every screen size and a description of the selected setting next to the list.
Settings save as soon as you change them (the footer says "Saved"); you no longer have to start the game to keep a change.
Update now shows the download progress and a Cancel button, and a failed download says what went wrong in plain words.
About & logs has an "Open the log folder" button.
